system.description:
Range 90ft; a 20ft-cube cage of force bars (gaps 1/2 inch) or a solid 10ft cube. Each creature in the area makes a Reflex save, slipping out on a success. A creature that fails is caged and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns: one success frees it, and after three failures the cage holds it for 10 minutes per level. Nothing passes through; teleportation out fails. Only Disintegrate destroys it. Material: ruby dust worth 1,500 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard
